confidence.definition: A recorded detector or review-priority score. Its meaning depends on the alert's calibration field; it is not automatically the probability that an attack occurred.
limitations: Compare scores only when their detector and calibration basis match.

novelty score.definition: A comparison between an observed flow window and an approved benign reference. A rare observation may be malicious or may be a legitimate operational change.
limitations: It does not prove a zero-day vulnerability or identify a CVE.

stix.definition: Structured Threat Information Expression, the structured format used for the alert record and its evidence extensions.
limitations: A STIX Indicator is evidence for investigation, not an automatic block instruction.

treeshap.definition: Feature contributions explaining a LightGBM model output in its configured output space.
limitations: It does not establish the real-world cause of an incident.

data diode.definition: A physical one-way transfer boundary that permits copied traffic into the monitoring enclave without a reverse fibre path.
limitations: Receive-only software or a firewall alone does not prove a hardware diode is deployed correctly.
